# NumberDropdown

```ts
import { NumberDropdown } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A compact, numeric-only select for small closed ranges — page size, quantity caps, pagination counts. Composed from the reusable form elements: Input Label above and an optional Helper String below (neither shown in this Figma frame, included for consistency with Dropdown). Use Dropdown instead for text options; use this when every option is a number.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Label text above the field (renders an InputLabel, wired via htmlFor). |
| `showLabelInfo` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the label's 16px info icon. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required: appends the label's "(required)" suffix and sets the Radix required flag. |
| `helperText` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Helper text below the field (renders a HelperString, wired via aria-describedby). |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'0'` | Placeholder shown in the trigger before a value is chosen. |
| `options` | `(number \| NumberDropdownOption)[]` | — | The numeric options rendered in the menu, e.g. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]. |
| `value` | `number` | — | Controlled selected value. |
| `defaultValue` | `number` | — | Uncontrolled initial value. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: number) => void` | — | Fires with the new numeric value when the selection changes. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Field height: md 40px (24px arrow), sm 32px (18px arrow). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Dims the whole field and blocks interaction. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Field name for form submission. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Explicit id for the trigger (defaults to a generated id wired to the label). |


## Usage

```tsx
<NumberDropdown options={[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]} />
<NumberDropdown label="Rows per page" options={[10, 25, 50, 100]} defaultValue={25} />
<NumberDropdown size="sm" options={[1, 2, 3]} />
<NumberDropdown options={[1, 2, 3]} disabled />
<NumberDropdown options={[{ value: 1, label: '1 seat' }, { value: 2, label: '2 seats' }]} />
```

## Accessibility

- Radix renders a real listbox: the trigger has role="combobox", options have role="option", and the current value is announced.
- Keyboard: open with Space/Enter/↑/↓, move with the arrows, type-ahead to jump, Enter to choose, Escape to close — all provided by Radix.
- The label is a real <label htmlFor>; a labelless field must get an aria-label. The helper is wired via aria-describedby.
- Focus is conveyed by the primary border (--stroke-150) — restyled, never removed.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use it when every option is a number (page size, counts). | Use it for text options — use Dropdown instead. |
| Keep the option list short (≈5–10 values). | Use it for large open-ended numeric ranges — use NumberInput's stepper. |
| Always provide a label (or aria-label). | Use the placeholder as the label. |
| Set a sensible defaultValue when one exists. | Pre-open the menu to "show" the options. |
